g.text: The life of a case — who acts at each step, and what the step is for
(the assistant proposes; only the CSR's click changes the case)
Ask about an account in the chat
Look up the person on the line by email,
Ask the contact the security questions
Work the case in the chat
Review and edit the draft in the case panel,
Purpose: one customer matter, owned by one CSR
(SU-1, SU-14); only the assignee acts in it.
: the case is assigned to the CSR
Purpose: fix which account the case is about,
so every question and change has one account
context and one audit trail. Text the model
the tool result carries the name as stored
Refused as any read (AU-6): no card,
Purpose: record who is asking, so a change they
ask for is checked against what they may request
Purpose: record how sure we are that the contact
is who they claim to be, before anything they ask
pending change requests and approvals canceled
the reviewed summary stored on the case
Purpose: nothing stays pending, and the database
keeps what the case was about and how it ended.
From now on the case answers 404 to everyone:
it has no assignee (SU-14, explain-access D1).
Find the account; propose it as the case's subject
Purpose: a case stays about one account;
Check, list, explain — on the subject only
